remarks: A rare find in this oh so convenient walk to town location where sidewalks line the streets. Vintage 1929 Tudor style home with detached two car garage has been impeccably maintained both in and out. This timeless beauty has its original interior doors with glass knobs and boasts three bedrooms and one and a half baths. Oversized living room with fireplace extends into a window walled sunroom, offering an ideal space for a home office. Adjacent to the dining room, a seasonal porch provides a relaxing retreat and easy rear yard access. Galley-style kitchen includes a comfortable breakfast nook and walk in pantry. Professionally maintained landscaping, with gardens lovingly pampered, promise a picturesque outdoor experience. 2024 improvements include a roof on both the house and garages, new chimney, front door, front walkway, front and side entrance steps and more. Truly a minutes to everything location.
